name: novaride-rules-test
description: Security-rules tests for firestore.rules, run against the Firestore emulator. No credentials, no network beyond the first emulator download: the project id is a demo- id the emulator never resolves.

scripts.test: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-novaride "node --test --test-concurrency=1 rules_test/*.test.js"
